notes.subject: garamara
notes.rationale: קום gĩtũmĩte 'kũima'; maũndũ macio nĩmakearahĩka nĩgetha gĩkombe kĩarĩ kĩmwe kĩa mahũdra

notes.subject: ויריעו
notes.rationale: Rĩrĩa kĩrĩa kĩarĩ kĩrũngĩrĩro kĩrũngĩrĩtwo nĩ 'kũhũra-rora'; kĩngĩ kĩrũngĩrĩtwo nĩ 'kũigua-raa' — ASV ĩrĩ 'they shouted, and put them to flight' na JPS 'shouted, and fled'

notes.subject: ויריעו/ויניסו
notes.rationale: Ciarĩa ĩrĩ cia hũdra ĩrĩa ĩrĩ circum cĩa Kĩhibirania — nĩ mũthemba wa kũhikania maũndũ matatũ marĩa Meni arĩ kĩrore

translation: Na makĩgaramara mũndũ harĩa wayaguĩrwo, mĩhoko ya kĩamba ĩrĩa ĩngĩ; na kĩamba gĩothe kĩĩnyitithanagĩra-ĩnyitithania, na mahũra matũĩgĩe, na makĩhĩra.
